Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Rich
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/01/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 32 as introduced may increase the obligations of the Alabama Department of Insurance by an undetermined amount due to additional administrative costs associated with the regulation of reinsurers. This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 32 as passed the House of Representatives may increase the obligations of the Alabama Department of Insurance by an undetermined amount due to additional administrative costs associated with the regulation of reinsurers. This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Shay Shelnutt, Chairperson
Banking and Insurance
